comment: Pinned toolchain for Project Nirqoba. Bootstrap verifies every entry; nothing here is advisory.

llvm.why: The portable-mlir-toolchain release provides a prebuilt LLVM+MLIR SDK with MLIRConfig.cmake, mlir-tblgen.exe, and lld-link.exe. The noassert variant uses a smaller zstd window size for compatibility with standard decompression tools.
known_limitations: Release build: no LLVM/MLIR C++ assertions (noassert variant).
Only the release backends are enabled: AArch64, ARM, X86, BPF, WebAssembly, RISCV, NVPTX. X86 covers the Windows x64 target.
MSVC ABI with the dynamic Release CRT; a debug-CRT build cannot link against it.

cmake.note: Local 4.5.0-rc2 is accepted if the minimum is met; bootstrap records the exact version used.

test_dependencies.note: None. Unit tests use the in-repo harness in tests/support; no GoogleTest, fmt or vcpkg.
